content: Hello, this is Alex from Amazon Security. I'm calling regarding a security alert on your Amazon account. May I confirm I'm speaking with Jamie?
Yes, this is Jamie. What's going on with my account?

Thank you, Jamie. We've detected suspicious login attempts from an unfamiliar device. For your protection, we've temporarily restricted your account to prevent unauthorized purchases. I assure you, we're here to help resolve this quickly.
Oh no, I rely on Amazon for my deliveries and business supplies. How do I fix this?

Don't worry, Jamie, we'll take care of it together. First, I'll need to verify your account information to ensure I'm speaking with the rightful owner. Could you please confirm your registered email and the last four digits of your phone number?
Sure, my email is jamie.freelance@gmail.com and my phone ends in 7802.
Perfect, thank you. Now, our automated system is showing an attempted purchase of a high-value item, an iPad Pro, from your account. Did you authorize this transaction?
No, I definitely didn't. I haven't ordered anything expensive lately.

Understood. In that case, it's good you caught this. We'll need to secure your account before the fraudulent transaction goes through. Could you please check your Amazon app or site to see if you're able to log in right now?
I just tried, but it says my account is locked for suspicious activity.

That's part of the security measure. To restore access, we'll have to run a diagnostic. For your convenience, I can walk you through this process, it's very safe and standard. Are you at your computer or mobile device now?
Yes, I'm at my laptop.
Great. Please open your browser and go to www.amazon-support-check.com. This is our secure portal for resolving account issues.
Okay, the site is open. It's asking me to download something called QuickAssist.
Exactly. QuickAssist is our trusted remote support tool. It allows us to help you reset your account safely. Please download and run the program. Let me know once it opens.
Alright, it's running. It says to enter a code.
I'm providing you a secure access code now: 912456. Enter that, and I'll be able to guide you step by step.
Okay, I entered the code. What next?
Thank you, Jamie. I can now see your screen. For your privacy, I will not access any personal files, I'm just here to help reset your Amazon credentials and check for any unauthorized activity.
Alright, just want to make sure nothing else is touched. I have client documents on here.
Absolutely, your privacy is our priority. Now, as part of the recovery, we'll need to verify your recent payment methods. Could you open your online banking portal in a browser tab?
Okay, logging in now.

Thank you. I see you're using RiverBank. For security, we'll need to temporarily move your Amazon balance to a safe escrow account. This prevents any unauthorized withdrawals. Please click on 'Wire Transfer.'
Are you sure that's necessary? I don't want to lose any money.

I completely understand your concern, Jamie. This is a standard fraud prevention step, and once your account is secure, funds will be returned. I will stay on the line the entire time and answer any questions.
Alright... I've opened the wire transfer page. What details do I enter?

Please enter the following information: Recipient name, Amazon Recovery Team, account number, 8776543210, routing number, 021000021. For the amount, please transfer $2,000, which is the flagged balance.
That's a lot. I need to check my balance first.
Of course, take your time. Your security is important, and I'm here to help. Let me know when you're ready.
I have just enough to cover it. Should I proceed?
Yes, please complete the transfer now. Once done, I'll confirm receipt and immediately start restoring your Amazon access.
Alright, I sent the transfer. How long will it take?
Thank you, Jamie. I'll verify the transaction and keep you updated every step of the way. Your account should be back to normal within one business day.
